name.value: Taste of Village Indian Kitchen & Bar

description.value: Taste of Village Indian Kitchen & Bar is an authentic Indian restaurant in downtown Victoria offering a menu of over 150 dishes spanning tandoori sizzlers, biryani, street food, breads, and desserts, all prepared with fresh daily ingredients and traditional recipes. The restaurant highlights both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options across its broad menu, making it one of the more comprehensive Indian dining options in the city centre. Pickup and delivery are available directly through the website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms a live, active Indian restaurant at 980 Blanshard St, Victoria, BC V8W 2H3, with phone +1 (778) 433-3696 matching OSM. The ordering interface explicitly offers pickup and delivery, and the menu includes a dedicated 'Main Course - Veg' section with 26 items plus vegetarian tandoori options, confirming vegetarian availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag '11:00-13:00' appears to be a data entry error; the website consistently states hours ending at 1:00 AM, suggesting the intended OSM value should be '11:00-01:00'.
Minor capitalization discrepancy: OSM records name as 'Taste of Village Indian Kitchen & Bar' while the website uses 'Taste of village Indian kitchen & Bar'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active restaurant in downtown Victoria with a fully functional online ordering system, confirmed contact details, and a broad menu suitable for touring cyclists seeking a substantial meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Main Course - Veg' section with 26 items (e.g., Aloo Gobhi, Bhindi Do Pyaza, Bhartha) plus vegetarian tandoori options including Paneer Tikka and Malai Paneer Tikka
